<u>**Data Science/Bioinformatics Learning Objectives:**</u>

1. Import selected-model CoGAPS files, metadata tables, diagnostics, manifests, and rank-selection evidence in R or Python.
1. Check file inventories, table columns, object dimensions, sample metadata, and analysis units before interpreting model output.
1. Distinguish standard-path files included with the case study from large full-reproduction files stored outside the repository.
1. Join CoGAPS cell scores to subject, timepoint, and broad immune-cell-type annotations.
1. Reshape and summarize pattern scores by infection day, subject, and broad PBMC identity.
1. Create reproducible visual summaries from included analysis files while keeping R as the default path and Python as a first-class alternate.
